Package com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.adapters.out.paymentexecution

Class LedgerPaymentPortAdapter

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.adapters.out.paymentexecution.LedgerPaymentPortAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
PaymentLedgerPort
@Component @Transactional(propagation=MANDATORY) public class LedgerPaymentPortAdapter extends Object implements PaymentLedgerPort
Implements Payment Execution's ledger port using the extracted Ledger application service. Every operation must join its caller's transaction so execution state and monetary postings commit or roll back together.
